# massdriver_event_destination (Resource)

A place outside Massdriver that receives the organization's audit log events. See [event destinations](https://docs.massdriver.cloud/platform-operations/event-destinations).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "webhook_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "massdriver_event_destination" "production_deployments" {
  name    = "Production deployments"
  adapter = "HTTP"
  config = jsonencode({
    url     = "https://hooks.example.com/massdriver"
    headers = { "X-Team" = "platform" }
  })

  auth = jsonencode({
    headers = { Authorization = "Bearer ${var.webhook_token}" }
  })
  auth_version = 1

  event_types = ["deployment.completed", "deployment.failed"]
  attributes  = { "md-environment" = "prod" }
  condition   = ".data.metadata.deployment_action == \"PROVISION\""
}

output "webhook_signing_secret" {
  value     = massdriver_event_destination.production_deployments.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `adapter` (String) How the destination receives events. `HTTP` posts each event to a URL as a CloudEvent, signed with Standard Webhooks headers. Changing it replaces the destination.
- `config` (String) JSON-encoded settings of the adapter, such as `jsonencode({ url = "https://hooks.example.com/massdriver", headers = { "X-Team" = "platform" } })` for `HTTP`. The API returns it and it is stored in state, so put credentials in `auth`.
- `name` (String) Name of the destination, unique in the organization.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `attributes` (Map of String) Attribute values the event's entity must have had, such as `{ "md-environment" = "prod" }`. An event must have all of them. Empty receives events of any attributes. A change applies to events recorded after it.
- `auth` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) JSON-encoded credentials of the adapter, such as `jsonencode({ headers = { Authorization = "Bearer ..." } })` for `HTTP`. Write-only: it is not stored in state, and the API never returns it. It is sent when the destination is created and when `auth_version` changes. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later.
- `auth_version` (Number) Change this value to send `auth` again, for example to rotate credentials. If `auth` is not set when it changes, the destination's credentials are removed.
- `condition` (String) A jq expression run on each CloudEvent that `event_types` and `attributes` select. The event is sent only when it outputs `true`.
- `event_types` (Set of String) Event types the destination receives, or `<entity>.*` for every event of an entity. Empty receives every event. The `massdriver_event_types` data source lists the event types. A change applies to events recorded after it.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the destination is paused. Events wait while it is paused, and are sent when it is resumed. Massdriver pauses a destination when its sends fail for 24 hours (by default); the next plan then shows `paused` changing back to `false`, and apply resumes it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret that signs each request, in Standard Webhooks form (`whsec_` followed by base64). Give it to the service that receives the events, so that it can check the `webhook-signature` header. Empty for adapters that do not sign.
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE` or `PAUSED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by ID. `auth` is write-only and cannot be imported.
terraform import massdriver_event_destination.production_deployments 4f9b2c1e-8d3a-4c6e-9f1b-2a7d5e8c0b13
```
